verdict.rationale: Foreloop is a hosted SaaS that stores feedback submissions, intentions and tasks, so data region/residency is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. The fact that agents run in a checkout on the user's own machine concerns where code executes, not where Foreloop stores data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
